title: Ethereal Aerated Greek yoghurt Raita
description: A refreshing Greek yoghurt side dish, infused with the flavors of the Mediterranean. The briny taste of olives and capers pairs perfectly with the creamy yoghurt.
instructions: In a mortar and pestle, pound the fresh mint leaves and dill fronds until well bruised.
Add the Kalamata olives to the mortar and pestle and pound until the mixture is well combined.
In a large bowl, whisk together the Greek yoghurt, extra virgin olive oil, lemon juice, honey, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pounded mint and dill mixture to the yoghurt mixture and stir to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in the capers and spoon the raita into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Garnish with additional fresh mint leaves and dill fronds, if desired.
Serve chilled, garnished with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkle of freshly ground black pepper.
Note: This raita can be made ahead of time and refrigerated for up to 24 hours.
Before serving, give the raita a good stir and adjust the seasoning as needed.
